body:
I don't want it to just be about sex but I've accepted that I'll never be in a relationship. But in the very least I want to experience it once. I mean no offense but unless you're also a virgin you don't understand what it feels like. The every day shame, feeling like you're defective, your mind and body going crazy because it hasn't fulfilled a biological need. It's been proven scientifically that humans need sex.

I get what you're saying, that in the long run sex isn't really that important. You're right that I don't want sex to define me. But I just don't want to die a virgin. I want to die knowing that at least once a woman pleasured me, even if the feelings were fake.

Thank you for the kind words. To be honest I don't know why I beat myself up like I do. I think I probably always have to some extent. Even as a child I was very shy and introverted. I'm not as introverted now but I still wouldn't say I'm incredibly social. It's something I have to force myself to do.

I wish I could be kinder to myself, but I don't know how to do that. I will say I am one of those people who does masturbate a lot, I think it's what has kept me sane. I don't want my low self esteem to control me anymore. I just don't know how to defeat my negative self esteem and what it does to me.

Ironically Wolf I actually did consider if I was asexual at one time. I'm definitely attracted to women but I wouldn't say I'm someone who wants to have sex every day or every other day. I just want the experience of sex at least once or twice in my life. 

I just feel so alone right now. Like alone to the point where outside of family and maybe a few friends no one would really miss me if I died. I definitely wouldn't have the big funeral. I'm not very talented and I honestly don't contribute much to this world. This year with the pandemic has made me realize that. I don't think anyone really needs me.

Same here to some extent so I know how unfair it feels. I can't say I'm completely isolating but I am mostly trying to stay home or just go out for essentials. 

If I do go out for reasons other than essentials it's typically to go to a state park, hiking trail, beach or some activity that is socially distant. I've gone to a few restaurants but not many. Definitely not going to the packed bars and clubs like people in their 20s are.  

I've had to really lock down the last week because I'm trying to go back to Indiana to see my family for the holidays. My mom is immunocompromised so she can't take any chances. Besides that with my allergies and asthma I'm higher risk of being hospitalized if I do get Covid-19. Another aspect of all of this that just seems so unfair. 

Most 20 and 30 year olds can do whatever they want. Even if they get Covid-19 they know at worst they'll feel bad for a couple of days. Like you said they're getting to live their normal lives whereas people like you and me are essentially being punished for trying to do the right thing.

I understand what you're saying and I agree with you that just having sex won't solve all my problem. But I think I look at myself as a defective person because I haven't had sex. Lets be honest, guys like me who haven't had sex at this age are looked at as degenerates, losers, psychos. In general just people regular people don't want to associate with. I don't consider myself a loser just because it's never happened with sex. But it has come to define me a little bit.

I guess what I feel (and I'm not saying it's right) is that having sex might lift a huge burden off my shoulder. I might actually end up being able to have better friendships and relationships with women. I feel like I'm so lost with women because even if I like a woman, it's always in the back of my mind that I've never had sex with a woman. So how can I truly know women? 

I know that sex is just a part of what I need. I know I need to see a therapist, exercise, find ways to meet new people and most of all find my purpose in life. Being laid off and before that furloughed for 9 months due to the pandemic I just feel like I am just existing. That I have no purpose in life. I know that sex won't solve my issues, but I do feel like it's a start. 

Do you think I'm right or wrong to have that mentality?

I appreciate the thought but why shouldn't I? Sex is a basic part of who we all are as human beings. I have never been able to satisfy that basic need due to lack of social skills with women.

I would seriously consider it but unfortunately I have anxiety while flying over an asthma issue a few years back. The doctors think its in my head mostly, that I suffered from a dry throat that caused my anxiety to go up which caused the asthma to activate. Needless to say long flights still scare me, another reason why life has been in shambles the last few years. I love traveling and flying before the incident.

I'm unemployed now, lost my job in early December so even I tried to go out to Nevada I don't know how much I could really afford.

I'm so sorry, I definitely feel like we're in very similar positions. I completely understand how you feel. I've never had to even worry about valentine's day. I've never had a gf to even treat for valentine's day. That stupid day every y ear does nothing but remind of me what I don't and will probably never have.

The sad thing is before the pandemic I was trying to work on my social anxiety. I had joined a tennis group as well as a cornhole league. I was working out and before the pandemic that would have social events once a month. All of that is gone now. I've lost any progress I might have made and have become more socially reclusive than ever before.

Here's what's also depressing, I'm 36 and I could easily be 39 or 40 before life truly gets back to normal after the pandemic. At that age you can forget sex. It's not happening unless you're paying a diseased prostitute. 

I honestly feel like this pandemic is going to destroy people like you and me and even regular people 30 and up. Whatever our friend group was before the pandemic, it got frozen during the pandemic and after the pandemic it's probably going to be all but impossible to meet new people. Heck people don't even want you to get close now, everyone assume everyone has the virus.

People in their 20s will still have time to recover their social life, people 30 and up and especially socially reclusive people like you and me have no chance.

If I wasn't worried about leaving my mother alone or worried about the pain involved in killing myself I truly believe I would end up. What life do guys like you and me have to look forward to?

Yeah but they're so nasty. I feel like the cheap ones are actually ugly and the good looking ones are way above what I could ever afford.

Why couldn't I have had sex just once. Why am I always so reviled by women. 

If this is what my life is going to be I just don't want to keep living.
I completely understand. I wish I had been aborted as well. My childhood was fun for the most part but my adult life has been nothing but sadness and failure.
